top_themes.theme: Lassonde Industries Inc. Will Hold a Conference Call to Discuss Its Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
top_themes.mechanism: ROUGEMONT, Quebec, July 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Lassonde Industries Inc. (TSX: LAS.A) ("Lassonde" or the "Corporation") is pleased to announce that it will host a conference call to discuss its financial results for the second quarter of 2026 on Friday, August 7, 2026. Mr. Vince Timpano, Chief Executive Officer, and Mr. Francis Trudeau, Chief Financial Officer, will host the call.
